name: Parallax Drag Gallery
description: Full-width horizontal strip of image cards that you drag or swipe, with eased inertia and a parallax shift of each image inside its card as the strip moves.
contents: Horizontal strip of image cards with alt labels
behavior: Drag with mouse or swipe on touch to scroll the strip horizontally
Strip position eases toward the target each frame
Image background position shifts with progress for a parallax effect
Cursor switches between grab and grabbing
editableByProps: Images and alt text, number of cards
Card size, gap, padding, radius, image brightness
Background color class, container height class

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the starting parallax image offset
needsCodeEdit.where: bgPos calculation inside the tick function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image zoom used for parallax room
needsCodeEdit.where: w-[140%] -ml-[20%] classes on the inner image div

fixed: Window touchmove listener calls preventDefault, which blocks vertical page scroll during touch on the page while mounted
Window mouse and touch listeners are removed on unmount
